authoredScene.visibleRoles: two or three unique lesson roles; the speaker must be included
authoredScene.dialogue: speech bubble and voice text, at most 100 characters
authoredScene.background: background id approved by the selected world pack

callout.label: optional short label, at most 14 characters
callout.theme: neutral | question | warm | cool | violet | gold

materializedScene.speaker: character asset id resolved from speakerRole
materializedScene.characters: concrete placements resolved from visibleRoles and layout
materializedScene.voice: Fish voice resolved from the selected world pack

run.input: exact topic and packaged story world
run.approval: one approval covering at most three render attempts
run.provenance: format, version, plan hash, world pack, layout file, and runner version
run.audio: one generated clip per scene plus fixed music
run.inspection: technical checks plus agent-reviewed creative checks
